rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for saying that something is likely true.

example.jyutping: keoi5 jing1 goi1 zau6 faai3 dou3 laa3

rows.note: Use this for a probable guess when sounding somewhat less definite than 應該.

example.english: I will probably get back around three.
example.jyutping: ngo5 daai6 koi3 saam1 dim2 sin1 faan1 dou3

rows.note: Use this when the likelihood is based on what usually happens or is the expected outcome.

example.english: With rain this heavy, there will probably be a traffic jam.
example.jyutping: lok6 gam3 daai6 jyu5 do1 sou3 wui5 sak1 ce1
